b1-reformkor-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Széchenyi's Offer
b1-reformkor-01.scenario: You are preparing for the citizenship interview. The examiner asks what István Széchenyi did in 1825. You answer in two sentences.
b1-reformkor-01.prompt: Tell the examiner what Széchenyi offered in 1825 and what came of it.
cues: Say how sure you are about a story
b1-reformkor-01.target: Széchenyi egyévi jövedelmét ajánlotta fel az országgyűlésen. Nyomában létrejött a Magyar Tudós Társaság.
b1-reformkor-01.english: Széchenyi offered a year's income at the Diet. In its wake the Hungarian Learned Society came into being.
b1-reformkor-01.canDo: I can say what István Széchenyi offered in 1825 and what came of it.

b1-reformkor-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Chain Bridge Tour
b1-reformkor-02.scenario: On a walk along the Danube a guide asks you what is special about the Chain Bridge. You answer, and also say who had to pay the toll.
b1-reformkor-02.prompt: Tell the guide what the Chain Bridge was and who had to pay.
cues: Say what kind of bridge it was
Say who had to pay the toll
b1-reformkor-02.target: A Lánchíd kétségkívül az első állandó híd volt Buda és Pest között. A hídpénzt a nemeseknek is fizetniük kellett.
b1-reformkor-02.english: The Chain Bridge was undoubtedly the first permanent bridge between Buda and Pest. The nobles also had to pay the toll.
b1-reformkor-02.canDo: I can say why the Chain Bridge mattered for Buda, Pest and the nobles' privileges.

b1-reformkor-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Kossuth and the Press
b1-reformkor-03.scenario: A history teacher asks you in class what Lajos Kossuth demanded and how his writings reached people. You are practising for the citizenship interview.
b1-reformkor-03.prompt: Tell your teacher what Kossuth demanded and what he said was necessary.
cues: Say what he demanded for the nobles
Say what he demanded for the serfs
b1-reformkor-03.target: Kossuth szerint elengedhetetlen volt, hogy a nemesek is adót fizessenek. A jobbágyok felszabadítását is követelte.
b1-reformkor-03.english: According to Kossuth it was indispensable that the nobles also pay tax. He also demanded the freeing of the serfs.
b1-reformkor-03.canDo: I can tell how Lajos Kossuth reached the public with the press and with speeches.

b1-reformkor-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Language Act
b1-reformkor-04.scenario: At the National Museum a guide asks you what happened in 1844 and what the Himnusz is. You answer for the citizenship interview.
b1-reformkor-04.prompt: Tell the guide what the 1844 act decided and who wrote the Himnusz.
b1-reformkor-04.target: 1844-ben a magyar lett a hivatalos nyelv. Kölcsey Ferenc 1823-ban írta a Himnusz szövegét.
b1-reformkor-04.english: In 1844 Hungarian became the official language. Ferenc Kölcsey wrote the text of the Himnusz in 1823.
b1-reformkor-04.canDo: I can say how Hungarian became the official language in 1844.

b1-reformkor-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Spring of 1848
b1-reformkor-05.scenario: The examiner at the citizenship interview asks about the days before the revolution. You answer with the place, the people and the date.
b1-reformkor-05.prompt: Tell the examiner where the young people met and when the revolution broke out.
cues: Say the date of the revolution
b1-reformkor-05.target: A fiatalok a Pilvax kávéházban találkoztak, köztük Petőfi Sándor. 1848. március 15-én kitört a forradalom Pesten.
b1-reformkor-05.english: The young people met in the Pilvax café, among them Sándor Petőfi. On 15 March 1848 the revolution broke out in Pest.
b1-reformkor-05.canDo: I can tell what happened in Europe and in Hungary in the spring of 1848.

b1-reformkor-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Reform Age in Review
b1-reformkor-consolidation.scenario: The examiner at the citizenship interview asks you to name the three most important people or events of the Reform Age.
b1-reformkor-consolidation.prompt: Tell the examiner who Széchenyi and Kossuth were and what the 1844 act did.
b1-reformkor-consolidation.target: Széchenyi felajánlotta az egyévi jövedelmét, Kossuth a Pesti Hírlap szerkesztője lett. 1844-ben a magyar lett a hivatalos nyelv.
b1-reformkor-consolidation.english: Széchenyi offered a year's income, Kossuth became the editor of the Pesti Hírlap. In 1844 Hungarian became the official language.
b1-reformkor-consolidation.canDo: I can synthesize the full 1825–1848 Reform Era saga.
